searchText: Do we have a kilnv2 spec out yet? Because I think teku has implemented it but it seems a bit dishonest to mark the milestone complete until the spec actually exists.. 🙂 Have you tried it with geth already? I created a branch for it `merge-kiln-jwt` on my fork You should be able to join the devnet with that I'm not sure if Enrico got to that overnight. I don't think so, but either I'll get to it later today or he should pick it up again in the EU morning. And yes, actually seeing it work with other clients is probably a good plan before really claiming it's complete too. Woo! Got JWT working between Teku and Geth. One key difference though is that geth's `--jwt-secret` option expects to be given the secret itself whereas the spec says it should designate a file containing the key. It seemed to happily use the file path I gave it as a key so not even validating it's hex. Not quite sure how it managed that... And it doesn't look like geth has `engine_exchangeTransitionConfigurationV1` implemented yet. Or it's not liking the way teku is calling it.
